// Fixture: a datastore import inside internal/session/ with no marker. The path alone grants
// nothing — ADR-0052's exemption has to be declared, or a future file inherits it by sitting in the
// right directory.
package session

import "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"

func Client(addr string) *redis.Client {
	return redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{Addr: addr})
}
